name: oma-space
author: Tussky
description: Arrange a Hyprland workspace the way you like it, capture it, and rebuild it on demand — with one bar tab per workspace, each hovering to show what is open in it.

barWidget.description: One workspace on the bar. Click to go there; hover to see its name and what is open in it.

schema.label: Workspace
schema.description: Which of Omarchy's ten this tab is attached to — the one Super+N reaches. Ignored while Scratch tab is on.

schema.label: Tab shows
schema.description: Icon and Name come from what is saved for this workspace; both fall back to the number while nothing is. Pick the icon in the tab's panel.

schema.label: Always on the bar
schema.description: Keep the tab on the bar while its workspace is empty. Off, every tab — scratch included — appears when a window opens there and leaves when the last one closes.

schema.label: Scratch tab
schema.description: Pin this tab to workspace 10 and never save it — the one workspace with no configuration. Like any tab it leaves the bar while it is empty; add Always on the bar to keep it there.
